WITH joined AS (
  SELECT
    dsr.id AS dsr_id,
    dsr.public_id AS dsar_public_id,
    dsr.tenant_id AS dsr_tenant_id,
    dsr.subject_user_id AS dsar_subject_user_id,
    dsr.request_type AS dsar_request_type,
    dsr.received_at AS dsar_received_at,
    lh.id AS lh_id,
    lh.name AS legal_hold_name,
    lh.subject_user_id AS legal_hold_subject_user_id,
    lh.reason AS legal_hold_reason,
    lh.is_active AS legal_hold_is_active,
    lh.placed_at AS legal_hold_placed_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY dsr.id
      ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(DATE(lh.placed_at) - DATE(dsr.received_at), 999999))
    ) AS rn
  FROM data_subject_requests dsr
  LEFT JOIN legal_holds lh
    ON lh.tenant_id = dsr.tenant_id
   AND (
        (dsr.subject_user_id IS NOT NULL AND lh.subject_user_id = dsr.subject_user_id)
        OR
        (dsr.subject_user_id IS NULL AND ABS(DATE(lh.placed_at) - DATE(dsr.received_at)) <= 3)
   )
  WHERE dsr.status = 'rejected'
)
SELECT
  j.dsar_public_id,
  t.name AS tenant_name,
  j.dsar_subject_user_id,
  j.dsar_request_type,
  DATE(j.dsar_received_at) AS dsar_received_at,
  j.legal_hold_name,
  j.legal_hold_subject_user_id,
  LEFT(j.legal_hold_reason, 200) AS legal_hold_reason,
  j.legal_hold_is_active,
  DATE(j.legal_hold_placed_at) AS legal_hold_placed_at,
  (DATE(j.legal_hold_placed_at) - DATE(j.dsar_received_at)) AS days_between,
  CASE
    WHEN j.lh_id IS NULL THEN 'no match'
    WHEN j.dsar_subject_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'subject_user_id match'
    ELSE 'tenant + date window fallback'
  END AS join_strategy
FROM joined j
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = j.dsr_tenant_id
WHERE j.rn = 1
ORDER BY j.dsar_received_at ASC, j.dsar_public_id ASC

Submitted. The query:

- Filters `data_subject_requests` to `status = 'rejected'` (expected 3 rows).
- Attempts the exact match on `tenant_id` + `subject_user_id` first; automatically falls back to a `tenant_id`-only match against legal holds placed within 3 days of `received_at` whenever `subject_user_id` is null on the DSAR row, picking the closest-dated candidate if several qualify.
- Exposes a `join_strategy` column so the DPO's analyst can see at a glance which matching path produced each row (or that no match was found).
- Keeps the grain at one row per rejected DSAR, truncates the hold reason to 200 chars, and orders by `received_at` ascending as requested.
